headlines.title: Is There A Risk Hiding In Comcast Stock's Latest Results?
headlines.summary: For a Comcast (CMCSA) holder, the average revenue per broadband customer is a troubling metric. That figure fell 3.8% in the second quarter of 2026. During the same period, Comcast lost 167,000 broadband customers. This leaves the company with a shrinking internet base where each remaining user generates less revenue on average. So why is Comcast collecting less from each broadband customer.

headlines.title: The Bull Case For Comcast (CMCSA) Could Change Following New Fiber Monitoring Tech And Rural Expansion - Learn Why
headlines.summary: In late September 2026, Harmonic introduced Recon, a new network monitoring and measurement family built on Comcast’s XMFR fiber technology and already proven in Comcast’s own network, to help broadband operators detect, locate and resolve fiber issues faster through continuous performance monitoring and cloud-based analytics.

headlines.title: Xfinity and Comcast Business High-Speed Internet Now Available to Nearly 2,000 Homes and Businesses in Hardee County, Florida
headlines.summary: WAUCHULA, Fla., October 14, 2026--Comcast expands Xfinity and Comcast Business services in Hardee County, making high-speed Internet available to nearly 2,000 locations.

headlines.title: The One Number Comcast Stock Investors Should Watch
headlines.summary: The wireless phone service stands out at Comcast (CMCSA), and it may be what buyers of the stock are betting on. While Comcast is widely viewed as a cable company, wireless is where it is adding customers. Yet the stock has lost 23% over the past twelve months, while the S&P 500 returned 17.3%. That divergence presents a contradiction. So, how big has Comcast's wireless business become.

headlines.title: Comcast (CMCSA) Stock Sinks As Market Gains: What You Should Know
headlines.summary: The latest trading day saw Comcast (CMCSA) settling at $20.66, representing a -2.59% change from its previous close.

description: Comcast Corporation operates as a media and technology company worldwide. The company operates through Residential Connectivity & Platforms, Business Services Connectivity, Media, Studios, and Theme Parks segments. Its Residential Connectivity & Platforms segment provides residential broadband and wireless connectivity services, residential and business video services, sky-branded entertainment television networks, and advertising. The Business Services Connectivity segment offers connectivity services for small business locations, which include broadband, wireline voice, and wireless services; and ethernet network services for medium-sized customers and larger enterprises. Its Media segment operates NBCUniversal's national and regional cable networks; the NBC and Telemundo broadcast networks and owned local broadcast television stations; and Peacock, a direct-to-consumer streaming services. The company also operates international television networks comprising the Sky Sports networks, as well as other digital properties. Its Studios segment operates NBCUniversal and Sky film and television studio production and distribution operations. The Theme Parks segment operates Universal theme parks in Orlando, Florida; Hollywood, California; Osaka, Japan; and Beijing, China. It also offers a consolidated streaming platforms under the Philadelphia Flyers and the Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania; and Xumo. Comcast Corporation was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
